$schema_note: Hand-curated record of how Hero Siege announces a rare ground drop in chat, for ForgePact#17 (Loot announcements). NOT mechanically extracted (see hs-game-sdk/curated/satanic_zone.json for why curated/ exists). Data only: no binding is generated from this file. Every entry carries its own `status`: `static_reading` (read from the compiled game locally and paraphrased in our own words; no script text is kept anywhere), `inference`, `not_established`, or `measured` (only `route.status`, from ForgePact#17's Live procedure 3). `scripts` is the announcement chain by SDK name, in call order. `rarity_key` is the itemInfoStruct key the closure is taken to read: that key "27" holds the rarity is measured (docs/RUNTIME_DATA_MODELS.md section 16.4), but that the closure reads it is an inference from the codes it compares, because the key strings were not read. `rarity_codes_in_closure` lists every rarity code the closure compares on a branch of its own, and for each whether the online path announces it; the list is what was read, and `announced_online` is `not_established` where the reading does not say. `route` is the call ForgePact's `lootann` ships to show the line offline: `server` (chosen 2026-10-04 after Live procedures 1 and 3; the game's own path, `method`, could not be tested offline (the probe's anon control did not resolve)). The argument is ForgePact docs/loot-announcement-research.md; the shared facts are docs/RUNTIME_DATA_MODELS.md sections 8.6 and 16.10. `chaos_tower_loot_burst` (ForgePact#227) records how a Chaos Tower floor holds its new ground items in Controller_obj.lootExplosionList until gml_Script_LootExplosion puts them back on the ground at the floor's end (docs/RUNTIME_DATA_MODELS.md section 16.12), with its own `status` and a `not_established` list.

ForgePact announces it (the owner's scope)

route.name: server
route.sink: ChatAddServerMessage by name with '<character> found <item name>' (itemInfoStruct["28"], the player's name), the red SERVER: line
route.why: the game's own path (method, the anon@1138 closure) was not reachable to test this session: the probe's anon control did not resolve (`anon rows resolved: 0 of 2`, instrument-blind), so whether the closure is bound on the ground item is not established; server ships per the owner's rule (route-method-2 not pass).

chaos_tower_loot_burst.read: 2026-10-23, local Ghidra project, the build the decompile index labels 498d588550d8; paraphrased in our own words

controller_variables.name: Controller_obj.lootExplosionList
controller_variables.holds: a plain ds_list of s_LootExplosionData structs, the floor's held ground items, read directly

controller_variables.name: Controller_obj.lootExplosionGiven
controller_variables.holds: a protected-store key, not the value; the flag behind it gates collection (collect while false) and LootExplosion sets it true

controller_variables.name: Controller_obj.lootExplosionGold
controller_variables.holds: a protected-store key, not the value; the gold the floor holds until the burst

list_entry.note: itemInstance is the item struct itself, a reference rather than a copy; nothing tests isPlayerDrop before the append, so a player's bag drop on a floor is collected too

scripts.name: gml_Script_LootGroundInit
scripts.role: on a tower floor (room name with the tower's prefix, the IsChaosTower test, or gDataProtected[12] true) outside the excluded rooms, while lootExplosionGiven reads false, appends the new ground item's struct to lootExplosionList and removes the ground instance

scripts.name: gml_Script_s_LootExplosionData
scripts.role: the list entry's constructor: itemInstance and isPlayerDrop

scripts.name: gml_Script_LootExplosion
scripts.role: the burst: sets lootExplosionGiven true, drops the held gold, then for each entry calls LootGroundDrop (a new Loot_Ground_obj given the entry's item struct, no CreateItemNew) and LootGroundInit with a second argument true, then clears the list

scripts.name: gml_Script_LootGroundDrop
scripts.role: called by LootExplosion for each held entry; its own body also calls LootGroundInit

scripts.name: gml_Script_anon@1312@gml_Object_Spawn_Next_obj_Create_0
scripts.role: direct caller of LootExplosion; reads chaosTowerFloorFinished, chaosTowerIsLastFloor, chaosTowerFloor, chaosTowerFloorList, nextFloorType and nextFloorNumber, so the burst comes when a floor is finished

scripts.name: gml_Script_WormholeGiveReward
scripts.role: the other direct caller of LootExplosion

chaos_tower_loot_burst.callers_found_by: a byte scan for direct call sites with positive controls; the MCP callers table was empty

reset.name: gml_Script_anon@16838@gml_Object_Controller_obj_Create_0
reset.role: clears lootExplosionList and resets lootExplosionGold, chaosTowerFloor, chaosTowerSpawnZone, chaosTowerStarted, chaosTowerBossState, lootExplosionGiven (false) and chaosTowerRift
reset.note: that it is what m_ChaosTowerReset holds is an inference

creation_guard_effect.note: the item that reaches the ground at the burst is the struct CreateItemNew built when it first dropped, frames or minutes earlier, so ForgePact's Loot announcements creation guard holds it as held-bag-drop and no line appears; until ForgePact#227's Live procedure 1
